decisions.reason: Changing the contact-page headline does not alter the available contact actions.
The headline change does not alter form submission recipients or lead delivery.
The early-access CTA can continue navigating to the same contact page regardless of its headline.
The source explicitly sets the contact-page headline, not the separate landing-page hero headline or body copy.
The contact-page headline does not change the landing page's composition, content types, image quantity, or screenshot policy.
The phrase 'Founding Dealer' is contact-page copy and does not change the dealer-login button or its placement.
The contact-page headline has no necessary effect on the founder image at the bottom of the landing page.
The contact-page headline does not modify the hero product visualization, controls, gallery, or device presentation.
Setting contact-page text does not change the landing page's visual aesthetic, branding assets, or style reference.
